title: Worklease resource history
description: Sanitized deterministic history for one exact local resource. Each retained acquisition epoch has source=epoch, operation summaries have source=operation, reconciliation summaries have source=reconciliation, termination snapshots have source=termination, and current claim snapshots have source=current-claim. These are retention-bounded local diagnostic records, not an audit log, attestation, provider evidence, or complete event archive. The completeness and coverage objects are derived projection metadata and have no source.

Source.description: Fixed retained-record category: epoch is the acquisition row (including a bundle epoch), operation is an operation row, reconciliation is a reconciliation row, termination is an epoch termination row, and current-claim is the current singleton or bundle claim snapshot.

Coverage.description: Derived retained-window metadata. Revision coverage cannot identify exact missing events: GC and pre-migration history are indistinguishable, and non-acquisition mutations also consume resource revisions. A null earliest revision means no retained epoch has a stamped acquisition revision; the resource watermark is independent and may remain present in a retained tombstone. A never-seen resource has both revisions null and a zero legacy-incomplete count.

earliestRetainedAcquisitionRevision.description: Minimum non-null acquisition revision among retained singleton and bundle-member epochs for the requested resource, or null when none is retained.

resourceRevisionWatermark.description: Monotonic revision watermark from resources, including its retained tombstone; it is not an acquisition-event count.

legacyIncompleteCount.description: Number of retained epochs whose completeness is legacy-incomplete.

Operation.description: A safe summary of one retained operation row. Reconciliation-derived outcomes remain in the separate reconciliation object.

Reconciliation.description: A safe summary of one retained reconciliation row. Its observed outcome is not folded into the target operation summary.

Termination.description: The retained terminal snapshot. When present, consumers may project the half-open held-at interval acquiredAt <= T < termination.effectiveAt; this is a rule over retained local rows, not an audit fact.

CurrentClaim.description: The current singleton or bundle claim snapshot. When present on an open epoch, consumers may project acquiredAt <= T < currentClaim.expiresAt. Open describes retained epoch closure, not active or current-clock activity; this interval rule is not an audit fact.

Epoch.description: The acquisition object and its retained related records. source=epoch identifies the acquisition row; completeness is derived metadata and has exactly one of complete, open, or legacy-incomplete. A legacy-incomplete epoch without a termination or currentClaim end source has an unknown upper bound.

completeness.description: Derived in precedence order without a clock: legacy-incomplete when acquisitionRevision is null or both termination and matching currentClaim are absent; otherwise open when currentClaim is present and termination is null; otherwise complete when termination is present. open is not active.
